shortDescription: The euro zone's current account surplus narrowed in July to €27.6 billion from €35.1 billion a month earlier, European Central Bank data showed on Friday.The surplus amounted to 1.7% of euro area GDP for the 12 months to July, down from 1.9% one year earlier.

children: The euro zone's current account surplus narrowed in July to €27.6 billion from €35.1 billion a month earlier, European Central Bank data showed on Friday.
The surplus amounted to 1.7% of euro area GDP for the 12 months to July, down from 1.9% one year earlier.
